limitations: Original supplied labels and four authored adjudications are preserved. Situation descriptors are not full conversations or independent truth. Agreement and pass propensity are not accuracy. The bootstrap preserves item pairs but does not establish population coverage; undefined draws are reported separately. Binary projection conditions on decidability. Binomial agreement bounds assume IID sampled paired items; this authored fixture does not establish that sampling. Assignment outputs and all potential ratings are deliberately constructed, not collected from humans or agents. Hashes establish local content binding, not authenticated provenance or historical registration.
